slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: ask
slots.about: the question in the soft card on top: what was true today

slots.name: items
slots.about: the things that can be true on a day: id (1 up), name, on (false); 0 or more, the rows follow this order

slots.name: hint_line
slots.about: the line under the card; may read picked_count (ticked today) and item_count

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: shown in place of the rows when items is empty

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the footer line once today is checked in; may read saved_count (things kept with today's check-in) and day_count (days checked in)

slots.name: toggle
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: ticks or unticks one thing for today; after the check-in the same tap rewrites today's record (one undo step)

slots.name: check_in
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps today with what is ticked, nothing ticked counts too; the label is the button's words

empty.shows: empty_note in place of the hint and rows; the check-in still works

fallback.shows: ticks from an earlier day read as cleared, the first tick today starts fresh

attention.shows: done_row in place of check_btn; a tick after it rewrites today's record

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink, snappy and swap
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a ticked row swaps the empty ring for a filled check, and the hint counts the ticks
